#assessment

“Assessment is one of the lines where we determine the Haves and Have Nots, where we can change the trajectory of somebody’s life because of the way we are assessing. I want us to have a pit in our stomach about the possibility that our assessments are getting it wrong. That’s what I’m talking about. The Line. Our tolerance for false positives– less than our tolerance for false negatives… Hal Plotkin
